## Why

The full-scope workflow-sync candidate plan sha256:7fd1614bc583c7b469ffdc358125ef5a9f06a8a8aec64d9d4946625164482717 is blocked by Travel-Plan-Permission#1638 active Codex P1 thread PRRT_kwDOPrFQ5c6mi6Aq on exact head c16006e24ec2640955aa3aac9a71d3da3f564314. Workflows source repair #3601 merged as 43153eec2d46863ca788896343b5c4a8f7212089 and is bound to that generated delivery, but there is no reviewer thread disposition on this head. Maint71 run 36414198325 reports review_blocked. Its request-only reassessment handler currently rejects workflow-sync branches and accepts only dev-tool-sync, so the originating reviewer cannot be asked through the owning workflow. The campaign must not resolve or merge this generated PR directly.

## Scope

Extend the existing source-owned Maint71 exact-head reviewer-reassessment request path to trusted workflow-sync candidate and delivery branches. Keep the request bound to repository, PR, exact head, active thread, immutable plan, generation, source commit, valid delivery lease and originating reviewer. Reuse the configured review command with durable URL/time/head evidence and duplicate protection. The request-only job must never resolve a thread, seal, merge, close, or authorize promotion.

## Non-Goals

- Do not directly mutate generated PRs from this issue implementation.
- Do not treat source-fix ancestry, green checks, or a generic clean review as explicit thread satisfaction.
- Do not relax plan, lease, signature, reviewer, seven-minute or zero-active-thread gates.

## Tasks

- [ ] Extend .github/scripts/maint71_merge_sync_prs.js reassessment validation for the workflow-sync lane while preserving all current identity, source, lease, complete-thread, origin and idempotency checks.
- [ ] Keep .github/workflows/maint-71-merge-sync-prs.yml repository-dispatch request-only routing distinct from reconciliation; change the workflow only if necessary for the new lane.
- [ ] Add workflow-sync positive and negative cases to .github/scripts/__tests__/maint71_merge_sync_prs.test.js and tests/workflows/test_sync_delivery_liveness.py, including mismatched plan/head/thread, expired lease, ambiguous POST, deduplicated replay, and zero resolution/merge calls.
- [ ] Update docs/ops/CONSUMER_REPO_MAINTENANCE.md with the exact operator route. Update workflow inventory docs if the workflow contract changes; no consumer template/manifest change unless a consumer-managed surface actually changes.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Focused JS and Python tests pass and demonstrate one source-owned exact-head Codex reassessment request for a workflow-sync PR, with a deduplicated replay.
- [ ] Wrong/stale binding and incomplete thread evidence fail closed.
- [ ] A requested or generic clean review alone cannot resolve an active finding or authorize canary promotion/merge; explicit thread disposition and ordinary exact-head gates remain required.
- [ ] The implementation PR is open ready for review with exact validation evidence.
